q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: SELECT S.NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S LEFT JOIN ORDERS AS O ON S.SALES_ID = O.SALES_ID LEFT JOIN COMPANY AS C ON C.COM_ID = O.COM_ID GROUP BY S.NAME HAVING COUNT(ORDER_ID) = 0 OR SUM(C.NAME = 'RED') <= 0

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 checks if a salesperson has no orders from the 'RED' company, while Q2 checks if a salesperson has no orders or all of their orders are not from the 'RED' company.
